verdict.rationale: SumUp's own docs describe sandbox merchant accounts with a full set of test cards for successful, failed, and 3D Secure flows. They also cover a Virtual Solo reader that pairs with a sandbox account so in-person checkout can be tested before switching to a physical reader. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, and explicit documentation that the MCP server or Agent Toolkit can be pointed at sandbox credentials for agent-driven testing.
